_comment: Who and where this installation is. Copy to agent/local/instance.json (gitignored) — `edva init` writes it for you. Read by lib/instance.cjs; each key can be overridden by its EDVA_* environment variable (shown in the right-hand comment of .env.example). Leave out what you don't use: an absent key falls back to the generic default (owner 'the user', the host's time zone).
